newsitem.title: UK: Laura Ashley drops on profit concerns.
newsitem.headline: Laura Ashley drops on profit concerns.

text.p: Shares in Laura Ashley Holdings Plc dropped sharply on Monday, hit by press reports which said the British fashion and textiles group was set to issue another profit warning, dealers said.

The Sunday Times newspaper and Monday's Daily Telegraph said the company was expected to issue a gloomy trading statement this week. The Telegraph said Laura Ashley would also announce a temporary halt to its expansion in the U.S.
"The shares have been in the doldrums for a while now but the bad news just seems to keep coming," one market-maker said. "It seems there's another profit warning on the way."
Laura Ashley shares were 4-1/2p weaker at 56-1/2 by 0834 GMT.
The company last issued a profit warning in April.
